title: Irish Zesty Soup
description: A comforting and flavorful vegan soup that combines the best of Irish and zesty flavors.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the Irish potato and vegetable broth, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the zesty lemon juice.
Blend the soup with an immersion blender or a regular blender.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Optional: Add some chopped fresh herbs like parsley or chives for garnish.
